author: iKronix_Gaming
body: Can a senior mod please reply to my appeal by email. I have been waiting for ages and I need to get unbanned. It's for the whole weekend and I got tempbanned for being told something different by a mod. Avicus is the only server I properly love. Please appeal me. Look on support@avicus.net for my formal appeal.
